ANDHRA PRADESH PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION: VIJAYAWADA 
NOTIFICATION.NO.29/2026, DATED: 27/11/2026 
DIRECT RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF ENDOWMENTS 
IN A.P. CHARITABLE AND HINDU RELIGIOUS INSTITUTIONS AND ENDOWMENTS 
SERVICE. 
(GENERAL RECRUITMENT) 
 
PARA – 1: 
 
1.1. Applications are invited through online from eligible candidates for Recruitment to 
the post of Deputy Commissioner of Endowments in A.P. Charitable and Hindu 
Religious Institutions and Endowments Service. The applicants shall apply online 
through Commission’s Website https://psc.ap.gov.in from 30/11/2026 to 
28/12/2026 up to 11:59 P.M. 
1.2. All desirous and eligible candidates shall apply online after satisfying themselves 
as per the terms and conditions of this Recruitment Notification. The details of 
vacancies are as follows; 
STATE WIDE POST 
 
 
 
 
Note: The Detailed break -up of vacancies may please be seen at Annexure-I. 
 
1.3. Any application sent through any mode other than the prescribed online mode 
will not be entertained under any circumstances. Submission of application form 
by the candidate is construed as he / she read the notification and shall abide by 
the terms and conditions laid down there under. 
1.4. The applicants who desire to apply to this post shall login into the Commission’s 
Website, with his/her registered OTPR ID/number. In case, applying for the first 
time to the posts notified by APPSC, he/she shall register his/her bio-data 
particulars through One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) on the Commission’s 
Website viz., https://psc.ap.gov.in Once applicant registers his/her particulars, 
an user ID is generated and be sent to his/her registered mobile number and 
email ID. 
 
Note: i. One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) is not considered as an 
application for any post under any circumstances. 
ii. The applicants are advised to retain their mobile number and 
e - mail ID registered in OTPR for receiving OTP/SMS for further 
communication. 
 
1.5. The selection to the post shall be on the basis of Written Examination. The 
examination will be conducted by the commission in online Computer based 
recruitment test (CBRT) mode. The date of Examination will be intimated later. 
 
1.6. The candidate is required to visit the Commission’s website regularly to keep 
himself/herself updated until completion of the recruitment process. The 
Commission’s website information is final for all correspondence. 
 
1.7. A general Mock Test facility is available to the applicants on the Commission’s 
website to acquaint themselves with the computer-based recruitment test. 
Applicant can visit the website and practice the answering pattern under MOCK 
TEST option available on main page of website https://psc.ap.gov.in 
 
1.8. HALL TICKETS for the written Examination will be hosted on the Commission’s 
website. Instructions would be given through the website regarding downloading of 
Hall Tickets.

1. He / She is of sound health, active habits and free from any bodily defect

such service; 
3. He /She possesses the academic and other qualifications prescribed for the 
post; and 
4. He/ She is a citizen of India. 
 
 Provided that no candidate other than a citizen of India may be appointed 
except with the previous sanction of the State Government and except in 
accordance with such conditions and restrictions as they may be laid down. 
Such sanction shall not be accorded unless the State Government are satisfied 
that sufficient number of citizens of India, who are qualified and suitable are not 
available. 
 
 PARA-3: EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION: 
 Applicants must possess the Educational Qualification as on the date of detailed 
notification. The date of this notification shall be the crucial date for calculating 
the experience including the practical experience.

PARA-4: RESERVATIONS: 
4.1. There will be Vertical Reservations in direct recruitment in respect of Scheduled 
Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections; 
and Horizontal Reservations in respect of Women, Persons with Benchmark 
Disabilities (PBD), and Meritorious Sports Persons (MSP) as per Rule 22, 22(A) 
and 22(B) of A.P. State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 as amended from 
time to time read with G.O.Ms.No.77, G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 02.08.2023 , 
G.O.Ms. No.03, G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 17.01.2024. G.O.Ms.No.46, GA (Ser-D) 
Dept., Dt: 19.04.2025. G.O. Ms.No.56.GA (Ser-D) Dept., Dt:15.05.2026 read with 
G.O.Ms.No.25, YAT&C (Sports & Youth Services) Department, Dated: 
15.05.2026. However as per Rule-13 of the Special Service Rules issued in 
G.O.Ms.No.245 Revenue (Endowments-I) Dept., Date:08.05.2002 and read with 
A.P. Endowments Act 1987( Act.No.30 of 1987) and its amendments. Candidates 
belonging to BC-C and BC-E Communities are not eligible to this Post. 
4.2. There shall be Reservation to Women horizontally to an extent of 33 1/3% in 
terms of Rule 22, 22 (A) and 22 (B) of A.P. State and Subordinate Service Rules, 
1996 as amended vide G.O. Ms. No. 77, GA(Ser-D) Dept., Dt:02.08.2023 and 
G.O.Ms. No.03, G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 17.01.2024. and G.O.Ms.No.46, GA (Ser-
D) Dept., Dt: 19.04.2025. 
4.3. There shall be Reservation to Meritorious Sports Persons to an extent of 3% in 
terms of Rule 22, 22 (A) and 22 (B) of A.P. State and Subordinate Service Rules, 
1996 as amended vide G.O. Ms.No.56.GA (Ser-D) Dept., Dt:15.05.2026 read with 
G.O.Ms.No.25, YAT&C (Sports & Youth Services) Department, Dated: 
15.05.2026. 
4.4. There shall be Reservations in respect of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 
(PBD) as per Rule 22, 22 (A) and 22 (B) of State and Subordinate Service Rules 
and read with Departmental Special Rules. 
 
3 
 
4.5. The Person with Benchmark Disability means a person suffering from not less 
than forty percent of any disability as certified by a medical authority except 
hearing Impairment. Hearing Impairment means a) “deaf” means persons having 
70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears; b) “hard of hearing” 
means persons having 60 DB to 70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in 
both ears; as per provision under The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 
2016 and The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017, dt: 15.06.2017 as 
per G.O.Ms.No.36, Dept., for Women, Children, Differently Abled & Senior 
Citizens (Prog.II), Dt: 23.08.2023. 
4.6. The following are the categories of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as 
per G.O.Ms.No.77, G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 02.08.2023 and G.O.Ms. No.03, 
G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 17.01.2024: 
a) Blindness and low vision 
b) Deaf and hard hearing 
c) Loco motor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, 
acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy. 
d) Autism, Intellectual disability, Specific learning disability, Mental illness. 
e) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) 
including deaf-blindness in the posts identified for each disability. 
4.7. Evaluation of various physical disabilities and procedure for certification will be 
as per orders contained in G.O.Ms.No.36, Dept., for Women, Children, 
Differently Abled & Senior Citizens (Prog.II) Dt: 23.08.2023. 
4.8. The candidates belonging to Backward classes (BC’s) applying for this 
Notification must produce Non Creamy layer certificate in terms of G.O. Ms. 
No.3, Backward Classes Welfare (C-2) Department, Dated 04.04.2006 read with 
G.O. Ms. No.26, Backward Classes Welfare(C) Department, Dated 09.12.2013 
regarding their exclusion from the Creamy Layer from the competent authority 
(Tahsildar) and issued on or after 01.04.2026 (after the completion of FY 2025-
2026) and must produce the same at appropriate time of verification. In case of 
failure to produce the same on the day of verification, he/she would not be 
entitled for the benefit of Reservation. 
4.9. Economically Weaker Sections means the persons who are not covered under 
existing scheme of reservations for the SCs, STs and Socially and Educationally 
Backward Classes and whose gross annual family income is below Rs.8.00 lakh. 
Only such persons are identified as Economically Weaker Sections for the benefit of 
reservations. The applicants/candidates who claim the EWS Reservation must 
possess the EWS certificate based on the income for FY 2025-2026 as issued 
by the competent Revenue Authority in the rank of Tahsildar in digital format 
only on / after 01.04.2026 (after the completion of FY 2025-2026) and must 
invariably produce the same at the time of certificate verification as per 
G.O.Ms.No:73, GA (SER-D) Dept,Dt:04-08-2021. 
4.10. In the case of applicants, who claim the benefit of reservation or relaxation from 
upper age limit on the basis of Caste/Tribe or Community/Category, the basic 
document of proof of Community/Category will be the Certificate issued by the 
Revenue Authorities not below the rank of Tahsildar in the case of 
BC/SC/ST/EWS and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued by the Revenue 
Authorities in the case of Backward Classes. The list of 
Caste/Tribe/Community is as incorporated in Schedule-I of APS&SS, Rules, 
1996. The detailed list is also appended as Annexure –IV of this Notification. 
The candidates have to produce proof of the community claimed in their 
application at all stages of selection along with the certificates relating to 
Educational Qualifications and local status certificates etc. Subsequent claim of 
change of community will not be entertained under any circumstances. The 
candidate is solely responsible for furnishing correct and complete information 
in the online application in this regard. 
4.11. Caste & Community: Community Certificate issued by the competent authority in 
terms of G.O. MS. No. 58, SW (J) Dept., dt.12/05/97 should be submitted at 
appropriate time. As per A.P. State and Subordinate Service Rules, Rule -2(28) 
Explanation: In so far as claiming for SC reservation is concerned, no person who 
professes a religion different from Hinduism shall be deemed a member of 
Schedule Caste. However, scheduled caste converts to Buddhism deemed to be 
4 
 
scheduled caste. BCs, SCs, STs & EWS belonging to other States are not 
entitled for reservation. 
4.12. Horizontal Reservation cuts across vertical reservation (in what is called inter-
locking reservation) and persons selected against the quota for Persons with 
Benchmark Disabilities / Meritorious Sports Persons have to be placed in the 
appropriate category viz. SC / ST / BC / EWS / Unreserved depending upon 
the category to which they belong in the roster meant for reservation of 
SCs/STs/BCs/EWSs as per G.O. Ms. No.77, G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 02.08.2023 
and G.O.Ms. No.03, G.A. (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 17.01.2024, G.O.Ms.No.46, GA (Ser-
D) Dept., Dt: 19.04.2025 and G.O.Ms.No.56.GA (Ser-D) Dept., Dt: 15.05.2026. 
4.13. The Rule of Local Reservation is not applicable to this post, as the post is State 
Cadre. 
4.14. Candidates seeking reservation/relaxation benefits available for SC ((Gr-
I/II/III)/ST/BC/EWS/PBD must ensure that they are entitled to such 
reservation/relaxation as per eligibility prescribed in this Notification. They 
should also be in possession of all the requisite certificates in the prescribed 
format in support of their claim as stipulated in the Notification for such 
benefits.(The Certificates issued in the name of applicant along with 
Father/Mother/legal Guardian’s (if parents are no longer alive) name only are 
acceptable). 
 
PARA- 5: AGE: 
 
5.1. Minimum 28 years & Maximum 44 years as on 01/07/2026, as prescribed under 
rule 6 of G.O.Ms.No.245 Revenue (Endowments) Dept., Dt. 08.05.2002 and read 
with G.O.Ms.No.187 GA (Ser-A) Dept., Dt. 14/09/2026.

1 SC, ST, BCs and EWS 5 Years 
2 Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PBD) 10 years 
3 Ex-Servicemen Shall be allowed to deduct from his age

length of service rendered by him in the 
armed forces/ NCC. 
4 N.C.C. (who have worked as Instructor in N.C.C.) 
 
5 
Regular A.P. State 
Government Employees 
(Employees of Corporations, 
Municipalities etc. are not 
eligible). 
Allowed to deduct from his age the 
length of regular Service under State 
Government up to a maximum of five 
years for the purposes of the maximum 
age limit. 
 
6 
Retrenched temporary 
employees in the State 
Census Department 
with a minimum service of 6 
months. 
 
3 Years 
EXPLANATION: 
Provided that the persons referred to at Sl.Nos.3 & 4 above shall, after 
making the deductions referred to in sub-Rule 12 (c) (i) & (ii) of A.P. State and 
Subordinate Service Rules not exceed the Maximum age limit prescribed for the 
post. 
The age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen is applicable for those who have 
been released from Armed Forces other than by way of dismissal or discharge on 
account of misconduct or inefficiency.
